sw3_symm_apply: The inverse coordinate exchange sends the nested triple z, x, y to x, y, z.
measurePreserving_sw3: The cyclic coordinate exchange preserves product Lebesgue measure.
convex_tri2: The closed triangle given by a at most x at most y at most b is convex.
convex_simp3: The closed ordered three dimensional simplex between a and b is convex.
hh2_tri: For a continuous convex function on a triangle, its integral is at most the triangle area times the average of its three vertex values.
tri2_cyclic_integral_eq: Cyclically permuting the barycentric coordinates of a triangle preserves the integral of a continuous function.
jensen2_tri: For a continuous convex function on a triangle, its integral is at least its value at the barycenter times the triangle area.
hh3_simp: For a continuous convex function on an ordered three dimensional simplex, its integral is at most the simplex volume times the average of its four vertex values.
simp3_eq_setIntegral: The nested interval integral on the ordered simplex equals its set integral for a continuous integrand.
simp3_cyclic_integral_eq: Cyclically permuting simplex barycentric coordinates preserves the integral of a continuous function.
jensen3_simp: For a continuous convex function on a three dimensional simplex, its integral is at least the simplex volume times its value at the barycenter.
equivFin3_prod_apply: The product representation of a three coordinate vector has coordinates zero, one and two in that order.
integral_posPow_sub: The interval integral of the positive part of an affine function to power k plus one is the difference of its endpoint positive parts to power k plus two divided by the slope and k plus two.
setIntegral_biUnion_finset_ae: The integral over a finite union of measurable sets with negligible overlaps is the sum of the integrals over its members.
volume_fin3_eq_coord_zero: The set where two distinct coordinates coincide has three dimensional Lebesgue measure zero.
match_cellKind_ne_box: For a shape other than the box, a case distinction between box and other shapes selects its second branch.
mm_pos_int_alg: The displayed normalized cell volume times the vertex gain bound equals the same quantity after clearing the scale denominators.
mp_m_lo_props: A nonempty lower clipped support interval has the stated positive endpoint and affine denominator bounds.
mpDropFn_continuousOn: The reciprocal loss function for decreasing intervals is continuous on each valid cell.
cell3_Mp_pt_gain: The weighted support gain integral divided by the positive parameter difference is at most the decreasing interval gain bound.
cell3_Mp_pt_drop: The weighted reciprocal loss integral is at least the decreasing interval loss bound.
cell3_Mp_pt: The normalized forward change of the weighted clipped integral is at most the decreasing interval gain bound minus its loss bound.
cell3_Mp_pos_bound: The integral of the decreasing interval gain bound is at most the scaled natural gain coefficient.
cell3_Mp_neg_bound: The integral of the decreasing interval loss bound is at least the scaled natural loss coefficient.
cell3_Mp_leaf_sound: The normalized forward change of the weighted clipped integral is at most the first natural coefficient minus the second, divided by the third order scale.
mmDropFn_continuousOn: The reciprocal loss function for increasing intervals is continuous on each valid cell.
cell3_Mm_pt_drop: The weighted reciprocal loss integral is at most the increasing interval loss bound.
cell3_Mm_pt_gain: The weighted support gain integral divided by the positive parameter difference is at least the increasing interval gain bound.
cell3_Mm_pt: The normalized reverse change of the weighted clipped integral is at most the increasing interval loss bound minus its gain bound.
cell3_Mm_pos_interior: In the full support interior branch, the increasing interval loss integral is bounded above by the scaled vertex upper quadrature.
cell3_Mm_pos_slab: In the partial support branch, the increasing interval loss integral is bounded above by the exact truncated affine ramp moment and the minimum reciprocal denominator.
cell3_Mm_pos_bound: The increasing interval loss integral is at most the first scaled natural coefficient of the leaf evaluator.
cell3_Mm_neg_bound: The increasing interval gain integral is at least the second scaled natural coefficient of the leaf evaluator.
cell3_Mm_leaf_sound: The normalized reverse change of the weighted clipped integral is at most the first natural coefficient minus the second, divided by the third order scale.
sw3: Cycle the nested triple from x, y, z to z, x, y.
s3_antitone_le: For a nonnegative decreasing function of x0 plus x1 plus twice x2, the integral on a valid ordered cell is at most the enclosing box integral divided by the shape factorial.
setIntegral_union_le_of_nonneg: For a function integrable on two measurable sets and nonnegative on the second, its integral over their union is at most the sum of the two integrals.
setIntegral_le_sum2_4: If two measurable sets cover a subset of four dimensional space and the function is integrable and nonnegative on both, its integral over the subset is at most the sum of the two integrals.
evalTree3_sound: For an integrable real function, a valid three dimensional subdivision preserves its upper bound by the first accumulated natural coefficient minus the second, divided by the third order scale.
G_fn_integrableOn: The clipped reciprocal integral, weighted by the reciprocal product of the first three coordinates, is integrable over a valid cell when phi is at most five A plus B.
I_fn_eq_G: When phi is at most five A plus B, the four dimensional Buchstab integral equals the integral of G weighted by the reciprocal product of the first three coordinates.
G_fn_sub_eq: The change in G is its support gain integral minus the parameter difference times the reciprocal loss integral.
integrand4_integrableOn: For strictly positive lower coordinate endpoints, the zero extended Buchstab integrand is integrable on a cell of each shape.
cell4_leaf_boundary_sound: When the lower corner lies below the support cutoff, the scaled cutoff volume estimate divided by the lower endpoint reciprocal denominator bounds the integral.
cell4_leaf_sound: At a grid parameter no larger than five A plus B, each valid four dimensional leaf evaluator bounds the actual Buchstab integral after division by the fourth order scale.
cell4_trans_leaf_sound: If the transition parameter is at least four B plus C, each valid transition leaf evaluator bounds the actual Buchstab integral for every later parameter.
diff_le_Mp: The forward integral difference is at most the positive parameter difference times the decreasing interval coefficient.
diff_le_Mm: The reverse integral difference is at most the positive parameter difference times the increasing interval coefficient.
cut3SumR: Define the alternating sum of eight positive part cubes at the subset sums of three shifts.
ramp3SumR: Define the alternating sum of eight positive part fourth powers at the subset sums of three shifts.
cut4SumR: Define the alternating sum of sixteen positive part fourth powers at the subset sums of four shifts.
I_fn: Integrate omega of the affine quotient over the ordered four dimensional domain, divided by the product of all coordinates and another factor of coordinate two.
centroid3R: Compute the standard affine vertex barycenter formula for the selected cell shape.
eval4Leaf: Compute the natural value used to certify a four dimensional leaf. Soundness uses the explicit parameter, cell and parameter range conditions.
eval4TransLeaf: Compute the natural value used to certify a four dimensional leaf beyond a fixed transition parameter.
evalTree4: Evaluate the supplied natural leaf function along the four dimensional tree using the stated subdivision rules.
evalTree3: Evaluate and combine natural pairs along the three dimensional tree using the stated subdivision rules.
cell3Set: Define the interval and order constraints for the selected shape. A triangle uses one shared interval for its ordered coordinate pair.
cell4Set: Define the selected first three coordinate cell and an independent fourth closed interval.
P: Choose Dx 9963008, Dp 10000, A 3435520, B 4083200, C 4528640, Sv ten to the tenth, S3 ten to the thirteenth and S4 ten to the fifteenth. Cache the indicated powers of Dx and Dp and the products Dp times B and Dp times C in the remaining entries.
